column3: Preserves “as He had spoken” rather than “what He had promised”.
The Hebrew does not name an object of the laughing; “her son” is not added.
Preserves sitting “opposite” and the wish not to see the death rather than an inability to bear watching.
Preserves “where he is” rather than specifying that he lies there.
Preserves swearing “by God” rather than “before God”.
